visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young female wearing a beige knit beanie and a navy blue 'STANFORD' sweatshirt sits at a light wood-grain table. She is holding a large red sharps-style container and pouring hundreds of capped medical syringes into a black shadow box frame. The background shows a white-walled room with a tall speaker and decorative posters. (2) A series of rapid visual cuts show close-up views of medical injections being administered to a person's lower abdomen. The shots vary between eye-level and slightly overhead, showing a needle entering the skin and a hand holding a digital camera to film the process. (3) The scene returns to the woman in the beanie, who is now holding a square black-and-white photo of a baby. She smiles broadly while looking at the camera. (4) She carefully positions the baby's photo inside the shadow box frame, placing it on top of the pile of syringes that now fill the bottom half of the frame. (5) Using a black marker, she writes on the side of the black frame while smiling. (6) She holds the completed frame up to the camera, which contains the baby's photo surrounded by the syringes, symbolizing the journey to the baby's birth. (7) The final shots show the frame mounted on a white wall in a nursery, illuminated by a warm lamp next to a white cabinet and a teddy bear. (8) A macro close-up highlights the texture of the clear and pink syringes piled together inside the glass-fronted frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Rapid, light percussive clattering sounds of plastic syringes hitting wood and other syringes. A calm female voice narrating in Mandarin with a gentle, slightly emotional tone. A soft, sentimental solo piano melody plays at a slow tempo in the background. (2) Sharp 'whoosh' and 'hit' transition sound effects are heard synchronously with the visual cuts of medical injections. The female voice continues with a lower, more reflective pitch. The piano BGM swells slightly in emotional intensity. (3) A louder, concentrated sound of plastic clattering as a large quantity of syringes is poured out. The narrator lets out a soft, surprised 'Oh my god' with high valence and moderate arousal. The piano BGM maintains a stable, warm major key harmonic progression. (4) Soft rustling of paper and the scratching sound of a marker tip moving across a hard surface. The female narrator's voice sounds closer to the mic, exhibiting a friendly and satisfied tone. (5) The audio track concludes with the continuous, peaceful piano BGM, ending on a soft resolved chord as the ambient room tone fades out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Flashback Compilation -> Resolution -> Result Display
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and celebrate a mother's sentimental tribute to her child, specifically highlighting the physical struggle and numerous medical injections (likely IVF) required to conceive, culminating in the creation of a meaningful keepsake frame.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video effectively uses the sheer volume of syringes as a powerful visual metaphor for the hardship of the IVF journey, contrasted with the joy of the resulting baby.
